title: chargehand run status, v1
description: A run that has not finished (HTTP 202 and 410 bodies), and the data of each progress event on /v1/runs/{id}/events. A finished run is read as result/v1.

status.description: queued and running: not finished. lost: the process that ran it ended before it finished. The rest mirror result/v1's status.

action.description: intake: the action intake chose; absent when intake stopped the request itself.

executed_action.description: intake: the action that runs; absent for a stop.

usd.description: node_finished: the node's cost, priced by the orchestrator's own table.

task_id.description: Driven sessions: the batch task the event is about.

pr_url.description: Driven sessions: the draft pull request.

usd_total.description: Driven sessions: the batch's cost so far, where the credential is priced.

turns.description: Driven sessions: assistant messages so far in the task's session.

tokens.description: Driven sessions: input plus output tokens the task's session has used so far (session_progress), or in all (task_finished).

stage.description: Driven sessions, session_progress: the change skill's step the session is on, by its latest tool call; absent until a call names one.

usd_estimate.description: Driven sessions, session_progress: the session's dollar equivalent so far, from the profile's price table (input, output, cache write and cache read priced apart). An estimate, not a bill, and present on a subscription too; absent without prices or when a model has none.

usd_estimate_partial.description: Driven sessions, session_progress: true when some message's model had no price, so usd_estimate sums only the priced ones; absent otherwise.

cache_read.description: Driven sessions, session_progress: cache-read tokens the task's session has used so far.

cache_write.description: Driven sessions, session_progress: cache-creation tokens the task's session has used so far.

memory_peak_mb.description: Driven sessions, session_progress: the most memory (MiB) the task's session containers have used so far, as the container engine measured it; absent when it could not.

actor.description: The account that started the run (ADR 0050); absent for a run started from the CLI.
